offices.evidence: A Zensar recruitment listing gives '3rd Floor, Tower B, Prestige Shantiniketan, ITPL Main Road, Whitefield 560048' (https://www.karnatakacareers.org/zensar-recruitment/); not on the company's contact page.

companies.name: Zepto
companies.description: Quick-commerce unicorn that moved its headquarters from Mumbai to Bengaluru in late 2024; OSM labels its office at Bharat IT Park on Sarjapur Main Road (Harlur) as 'Zepto HQ'. It is not an Embassy TechVillage tenant.

offices.label: Bengaluru HQ - Bharat IT Park, Harlur
offices.address: Bharat IT Park, Sarjapur Main Road, Ambalipura, Harlur, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: Deccan Herald (Aug 2024) reported Zepto moving its HQ to Bengaluru, considering Sarjapur, HSR or Bellandur, and OSM now maps a building named 'Zepto HQ-Bharat IT Park' on Sarjapur Main Road; no company page confirms it (https://www.deccanherald.com/business/companies/zepto-to-move-headquarters-to-bengaluru-by-november-3139761; https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/159980947).

companies.name: Zeta
companies.description: Banking-technology unicorn (SoftBank-backed, HQ San Ramon) founded by Bhavin Turakhia with most of its engineering in India; OSM records its Bengaluru office in Diamond District, but zeta.tech lists only the US HQ.

offices.label: Diamond District office
offices.address: Diamond District, HAL Old Airport Road, Kodihalli 560008
offices.evidence: OSM office POI 'Zeta' in Diamond District (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/13563559848); not on the company site (https://www.zeta.tech/).

companies.name: Zoho
companies.description: Bootstrapped Indian SaaS major (Zoho One, CRM) headquartered in Chennai with 15,000+ staff; its Bengaluru office is a unit in Signature Towers at Brigade Golden Triangle on Old Madras Road.

offices.label: Bengaluru - Signature Towers, Brigade Golden Triangle
offices.address: A-908, Signature Towers, Brigade Golden Triangle, Old Madras Road, Huskur Village, Bengaluru 560049
offices.evidence: Zoho's contact page lists 'A-908, Signature Towers - Brigade Golden Triangle, Old Madras Rd, Sy No 50, Huskur Village, Bengaluru 560049' (https://www.zoho.com/contact.html); Brigade Golden Triangle geocoded via Nominatim.

companies.name: Zolo
companies.description: Managed co-living and PG accommodation operator (Zolostays Property Solutions Pvt Ltd); corporate office in HSR Layout Sector 3.

offices.label: Bengaluru corporate office
offices.address: No. 1190, 22nd Cross, Sector 3, HSR Layout, Bengaluru 560102
offices.evidence: Listed as the corporate office on Zolo's own contact page, https://zolostays.com/contact ; point is the geocoded 22nd Cross Road, Sector 3.

companies.name: Zoomcar
companies.description: Self-drive car-sharing marketplace, Nasdaq-listed since its 2023 SPAC merger; its business address in SEC filings is Anjaneya Techno Park on HAL Old Airport Road, having earlier been in Tower B of Diamond District next door.

offices.label: HQ, Anjaneya Techno Park, Old Airport Road
offices.address: No. 147, 1st Floor, Anjaneya Techno Park, HAL Old Airport Road, Kodihalli 560008
offices.evidence: SEC EDGAR company record lists the business and mailing address as 'Anjaneya Techno Park, No. 147, 1st Floor, Kodihalli, Bangalore 560008' (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001854275&type=10-K); OSM maps the building.

companies.name: Zscaler
companies.description: Cloud-security (zero trust) company; its Bengaluru India Technology Center (est. 2016, ~2,400 staff per GCC trackers) runs from Bren Optimus in Adugodi and the Orion building of Bagmane Constellation.

offices.label: Bengaluru - Bren Optimus, Adugodi
offices.address: Bren Optimus, 3rd Floor, 8/2 Dr M H Marigowda Road, Dairy Colony, Adugodi, Bengaluru 560029
offices.evidence: Zscaler's contact page lists 'Bren Optimus, 3rd floor, 8/2 Dr. M.H. Marigowda Road, Dairy Colony, Adugodi, Bengaluru 560029' (https://www.zscaler.com/company/contact); OSM office POI 'Zscaler' is at Bren Optimus.

offices.label: Bengaluru - Orion, Bagmane Constellation
offices.address: 11th Floor, Orion Building, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, Ferns City Road, Doddanekundi, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: Zscaler's contact page lists '11th Floor, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, Orion Building, Ferns City Road, Doddanekkundi, Bengaluru 560048' (https://www.zscaler.com/company/contact); park centroid used.

techParks.name: 360 Business Park
techParks.description: New Grade A office park in Electronic City Phase 1 where TCS leased ~1.4 msf (Towers 5A and 5B) for 15 years in August 2025, with phased occupation from April and August 2026. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: 37 Cunningham
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: AKR Tech Park
techParks.locality: Kudlu Gate / Krishna Reddy Industrial Area, 7th Mile Hosur Road 560068
techParks.description: Office park at No. 112, 7th Mile Hosur Road by Kudlu Gate metro station; BHIVE Workspace runs a 3 lakh sq ft, 5,000+ seat coworking campus here (Myntra's former headquarters before its 2017 move to Embassy TechVillage, per older OSM data).

techParks.name: AMR Tech Park
techParks.description: Multi-building office park (AMR Tech Park I, II, 3A/3B, 4/4A per OSM) at No. 23 & 24 Hongasandra on Hosur Main Road, Bommanahalli, about 7 km north of Electronics City. Tally Solutions' head office, Sagility's Buildings 1 and 2A and Quinnox's AMR Tech Park-4 office are confirmed from company pages; HGS, Mindteck, MetricStream and Avaya are recorded there by OpenStreetMap only.

techParks.name: Anjaneya Techno Park
techParks.description: A small commercial building (No. 147) on HAL Old Airport Road beside Diamond District. Zoomcar Holdings' SEC filings give 'Anjaneya Techno Park, No. 147, 1st Floor, Kodihalli' as its business address.

techParks.name: Aurbis Business Park
techParks.description: Office building on the ORR at Devarabeesanahalli, west of Embassy TechVillage; OSM maps an eBay office inside it.

techParks.name: Bagmane Capital
techParks.description: Bagmane's largest ORR campus (launched 2017, 42 acres, 10.5 msf planned) east of Constellation at Doddanekundi Circle, with towers named for world cities: Luxor South and North (GSK's GCC, IBM/Apptio, EPAM, Encora, HCLTech, FAB), Kyoto West and East (Google's 8.7 lakh sq ft 'Kyoto Campus'), Rome South and North (Amazon, American Express), Angkor East and West (Qualcomm, Wayfair, Samsung Semiconductor India Research), Apollo, Troy (Synopsys) and the under-construction Memphis towers. Bagmane also lists Microsoft, BNP Paribas, Databricks and Arm; the Luxor campus (~1 msf) is being folded into the Bagmane REIT.

techParks.name: Bagmane Constellation Business Park
techParks.description: A 30-acre, 5.3 msf campus (2007) at Ferns City, Doddanekundi, on the Outer Ring Road south of Bagmane WTC, with towers named for constellations: Phoenix (Samsung R&D Institute India-Bangalore, #2870), Virgo (Qualcomm's 2.56 lakh sq ft 2025 lease), Carina East and West (Google, Red Hat), Orion, Aquila and Taurus 1-4 (Amazon's BLR14 and sister buildings; Arm's new 409,450 sq ft Taurus-4 North Tower). Bagmane also lists Boeing and Nvidia as occupiers.

techParks.name: Bagmane Cosmos
techParks.description: Bagmane's newest C.V. Raman Nagar campus (launched 2022, under development) immediately east of Bagmane Tech Park: five planned blocks of which Ariel (550,000 sq ft, Texas Instruments), Vesta (496,800 sq ft, Lam Research and Palo Alto Networks) and Ceres (550,000 sq ft) are named, 3.5 msf in all. It is the Bagmane REIT's growth asset in this cluster.

techParks.name: Bagmane Rio Business Park
techParks.locality: Mahadevapura, Outer Ring Road (west of Bagmane WTC)
techParks.description: Bagmane's built-to-suit park beside the WTC campus; OpenStreetMap names its main building 'Google Ananta', the 1.6 msf, 5,000-seat campus Google inaugurated in February 2025 as its largest in India. The Bagmane REIT records Rio as a 1.1 msf asset (93% stake being acquired), so the 1.6 msf press figure likely includes space beyond the REIT's leasable area.

techParks.name: Bagmane Solarium City
techParks.description: An 82-acre campus (launched 2017, 10.5 msf planned) on ITPL Main Road at the cusp of the Outer Ring Road and Whitefield, between Doddanekundi and Kundalahalli, with blocks named for noble gases - Neon, Xenon North and South, Argon, Helium, Radon - plus numbered buildings on the ITPL Main Road side. Occupiers include Cognizant, Carelon Global Solutions (Xenon South), Shell Business Operations, Schneider Electric's 0.48 msf R&D centre, Tekion, Northern Trust, Baker Hughes, Zebra Technologies, Omnicom/DDB and Visteon, with OSM also recording AMD, IBM, SAP Fioneer, Thermo Fisher, Harman, o9 and Netskope.

techParks.name: Bagmane Tech Park
aliases: Bagmane Tech Park CV Raman Nagar
techParks.description: Bagmane Group's first and flagship campus (launched 2001) on 42 acres at Byrasandra, C.V. Raman Nagar, bordering HAL and DRDO land east of the old HAL airport: about ten buildings - Olympia, Lakeview, Tridib, Laurel, Parin, Quay, Commerz, Crown and a dedicated Cognizant building - totalling 4.7 msf, with Bagmane's own head office on the 5th floor of Laurel Block B. The new 3.5 msf Bagmane Cosmos (Ariel, Vesta, Ceres) rises on its eastern edge. Anchors are Texas Instruments' India HQ (Lakeview), Dell's R&D centre, Volvo Group India's head office (Tridib), Cognizant, PwC's Acceleration Center and Palo Alto Networks (Quay), Motorola Solutions and Nike (Olympia), Infineon and OpenText/Micro Focus (Laurel), Grant Thornton (Tridib) and Lam Research.

techParks.name: Bagmane World Technology Center
techParks.description: A 28-acre SEZ campus (2007) on the K.R. Puram-Marathahalli stretch of the Outer Ring Road at Mahadevapura, 4.5 msf across gem-named blocks: Aquamarine (Visa, Ericsson, Mphasis' corporate HQ), Citrine (Ericsson, Arm, Microland), Peridot (Accenture, AB InBev GCC), Amber (Boeing, Extreme Networks), Moonstone / the Dell EMC towers, Coral (EY GDS), the 993,000 sq ft Goldstone tower (Samsung R&D, Nvidia) and Opal (Google). Google's Bagmane Rio campus adjoins it to the west and Bagmane Constellation to the south.

techParks.name: Barton Centre
techParks.description: Older mixed-use office block at 84 MG Road; mainly small professional firms, no large anchor tenant could be verified.

techParks.name: BEL Bengaluru Complex (Jalahalli)
techParks.description: BEL's founding (1954) factory campus at Jalahalli, holding the Bangalore unit, Central Research Laboratory, Product Development & Innovation Centre, BEL Academy for Excellence, the BEL-Thales Systems joint venture and DRDO's MTRDC. Point is Nominatim's 'Bharat Electronics Limited' feature; no named polygon in the OSM extract.

techParks.name: Bengaluru Aerospace Park
techParks.description: KIADB's aerospace and defence SEZ beside the airport; Dynamatic Technologies moved its registered office to its Aerotropolis campus here and Centum Electronics operates a unit.

techParks.name: Bharat IT Park
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: Bhartiya Centre of Information Technology
techParks.description: The office component of Bhartiya City, Bhartiya Urban's 125-acre township on Thanisandra Main Road: blocks BCIT 1, 2, 3A and 3B are complete and occupied, with The Leela hotel alongside. The developer's page quotes 4.1 million sq ft of workspace in one place and 'over 2 million' in another (the latter likely the built phase). Tenant names come from the developer's logo wall, with OSM POIs confirming most of the larger occupiers. The brief's Sony, Micron, Lowe's, Shell and Ericsson guesses are not on the developer's list.

techParks.name: Bhoruka Tech Park
techParks.description: Older industrial-estate office campus on Whitefield Road at Garudachar Palya/Hoodi, next to Brigade Metropolis; Tata Elxsi's own contact page lists Block I here, and OSM maps an ABB block and a Hitachi Energy office on the same plot.

techParks.name: Bidadi Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB's automotive-led industrial area 30 km south-west of the city on the Mysuru road, anchored by Toyota Kirloskar Motor's two assembly plants.

techParks.name: Biocon Park
techParks.description: Biocon's integrated research and biologics manufacturing campus and SEZ at Bommasandra, south of Electronics City; Wikipedia pictures the Biocon Research Centre inside it and Syngene is headquartered there. Mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/545039647.

techParks.name: Boeing India Engineering and Technology Center
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: Bommasandra Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB's large manufacturing estate south of Electronics City on Hosur Road (OSM operator KIADB, way/103293015), home to bearing, tooling, pharma and EV plants; Narayana Health's hospital campus is also here but is excluded as a hospital. Biocon Park adjoins it on the Jigani link road.

techParks.name: Bosch Adugodi Campus
techParks.description: Bosch's 76-acre India headquarters campus on Hosur Road at Adugodi, redeveloped as the 'Spark.NXT' smart campus; the historic MICO site since 1951.

techParks.name: Brigade Magnum
techParks.description: Brigade's Grade-A office block on Bellary Road just north of the Hebbal flyover, next to RMZ Latitude and Brigade Opus. Tenants are OSM POIs only (Citi, PwC, Gallagher, ABB); Brigade's commercial listing page no longer features the project, so nothing was verified from the developer.

techParks.name: Brigade Metropolis
techParks.locality: Garudachar Palya, Mahadevapura (Whitefield Road / ITPL Main Road)
techParks.description: Brigade's 40-acre integrated township on Whitefield Road; its office component is Summit (Towers A/B, the B-9 building on ITPL Main Road) plus The Arcade retail-and-small-office block. Awfis runs a coworking centre there and Kapture CX is headquartered on the 11th floor; Capgemini, Volvo and EY offices are mapped on the Summit towers.

techParks.name: Brigade Opus
techParks.description: Brigade office building at 70/401 Kodigehalli Main Road off Bellary Road, Hebbal; Hitachi Energy India's registered office (8th floor) per its filings. OSM places the Hitachi Energy POI and a cluster of other offices (Epson, Accenture, Berkadia, Netsmart, TerraPay, Westermo, Gallagher, ReSource Pro, Awfis) about 300 m north in a block it names 'Godrej Downtown'; that name could not be verified and those tenants are recorded against the block rather than this building.

techParks.name: Brigade Rubix
techParks.description: Brigade Group's 2-basement + ground + 11-floor office building on HMT Link Road near the HMT township, with 14,000 sq ft typical floor plates, marketed to firms wanting to be near Wipro and ABB in Peenya; tenants not published.

techParks.name: Brigade Senate
techParks.description: Brigade's two-building office complex (Senate 1 and Senate 2) off Bellary Road at Hebbal-Kempapura, bordering Sahakar Nagar; the space startup Digantara is headquartered on Floor 9 of Senate 2.

techParks.name: Brigade Tech Gardens
techParks.description: Brigade Enterprises' office campus in Brookefield off ITPL Main Road, laid out as lettered blocks (B1, B2 ...); Manhattan Associates India's development centre occupies the 5th and 6th floors of B1 Block.

techParks.name: Brigade Twin Towers
techParks.description: Twin office towers by Brigade on the Tumkur Road / Outer Ring Road junction at Goraguntepalya, opposite the under-construction RNS Business Park; mapped in OSM (way 133883061). No tenant list was found.

techParks.name: Cessna Business Park
techParks.description: Office park immediately north-east of Embassy TechVillage, across the Kadubeesanahalli service road, on the ORR. Recorded here only because it is genuinely adjacent to ETV: Cisco's main Bengaluru campus (OSM way 1248882471) and the Aloft Bengaluru Cessna Business Park hotel are inside it. Other researchers' lenses cover its full roster.

techParks.name: Diamond District
techParks.description: A late-1990s mixed-use estate on HAL Old Airport Road at Kodihalli: residential towers around a commercial block (Towers A-D) that has long housed startups and tech offices. OSM records Gojek's India engineering centre, Zeta, the NASSCOM 10,000 Startups warehouse (Tower D) and a BHive coworking centre here; Zoomcar's registered office was Tower B, 7th floor before it moved to Anjaneya Techno Park next door, and apna was recorded here before listing an Ejipura address. OSM tags the operator as IBC Group, which could not be verified.

techParks.name: Divyasree Greens
techParks.description: A mid-size office campus on the Intermediate Ring Road immediately west of Embassy GolfLinks, on survey numbers 12/1, 12/2A and 13/1A of Challaghatta village. Atlassian's own contact page places its Bengaluru office on the 4th and 5th floors; OSM also records a Dell India office in the compound.

techParks.name: Divyasree Technopolis
techParks.description: DivyaSree's IT park at 124/125 Yemalur Main Road off Old Airport Road, east of HAL Airport, with the newer DivyaSree 77 East / 77 Town Centre blocks beside it. CGI's offices page confirms its Bengaluru centre here; OSM records Thomson Reuters and Deloitte. Centroid is derived from the OSM tenant POIs because the park polygon is not drawn in OSM. Walmart Global Tech, Microsoft, Myntra, Sapient, Hitachi and Mu Sigma, suggested by the lens prompt, could not be confirmed as tenants.

techParks.name: DRDO Complex, C V Raman Nagar
aliases: DRDO Phase 1, C V Raman Nagar
DRDO Township C V Raman Nagar
techParks.description: DRDO's Bengaluru campus at C V Raman Nagar housing LRDE (radars), CAIR (AI and robotics), CASDIC (ex-DARE avionics) and GTRE (aero-engines), with HAL's Engine Division and IMGT Division next door. Centroid averaged from the LRDE, CAIR and GTRE OSM polygons.

techParks.name: Ebisu Tech Park
techParks.locality: Nagavara (Hebbal Outer Ring Road, beside Manyata south gate)
techParks.description: Under construction per OSM, between the Manpho Convention Centre and the Manyata NXT towers on the Nagavara side of the ORR; no tenants yet.

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 1
techParks.locality: Electronic City (west of Hosur Road), Bengaluru 560100
techParks.description: The original KEONICS township (founded 1978 by R. K. Baliga; about 800 acres across all phases, roughly 200 IT/ITES campuses, maintained since 1997 by the Electronics City Industrial Township Authority, ELCITA). Phase 1 is the older, mostly west-of-Hosur-Road core holding the Infosys and Wipro headquarters campuses, the Siemens/3M/BHEL/HP strip along Hosur Road, the E-City towers at Veerasandra and the C-DOT, C-DAC and STPI government campuses. Coordinates and bbox are derived from the cluster of Phase 1 features in OpenStreetMap, not from an official boundary.
notableTenants: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 2
aliases: KIADB Industrial Area Phase II Electronic City
techParks.locality: Electronic City (east of Hosur Road) / Doddathogur / Veerasandra, Bengaluru 560100
techParks.description: The KIADB-developed eastern extension of Electronics City (the 'KIADB Industrial Area, Phase II, Electronic City' of company addresses), reached from Hosur Road via Shantipura Main Road and Infosys Avenue. It holds the TCS Think Campus, Tech Mahindra's plots 45-47, Continental's Technical Center India, Aurigene (plots 39-40), Hical (plots 46-47), the Gold Hill parks and the Veerasandra Industrial Estate with Titan's 'Integrity' office and Tessolve. Coordinates and bbox are derived from the cluster of Phase 2 features in OpenStreetMap.

techParks.name: Embassy Business Hub
techParks.developer: Embassy Group / Embassy Office Parks REIT
techParks.description: Embassy REIT's 59-acre campus-style business park on Bellary Road in North Bengaluru, about 20 minutes from the airport: 1.4 million sq ft leasable, of which 0.4 msf is complete and 100% committed to a single occupier and 1.0 msf is in early development. OSM maps the completed parcel as 'Embassy Business Hub - Philips' with a Philips Innovation Campus POI; the REIT page does not name the occupier.

techParks.name: Embassy GolfLinks Business Park
techParks.locality: Challaghatta / Domlur, Koramangala-Indiranagar Intermediate Ring Road
techParks.description: A 37.11-acre low-rise campus beside the Karnataka Golf Association course at Challaghatta, off the Intermediate Ring Road between Domlur and Koramangala. Its blocks are named after golf courses (Augusta, Cherry Hills, Cinnabar Hills, Crystal Downs, Cypress Point, Pacific Dunes, Pebble Beach, Pine Valley, Pinehurst, St. Andrews / Signature, Sunningdale, Sunriver, Torrey Pines) and OSM records them individually. Embassy REIT reports 3.4 msf of leasable area (3.1 msf completed), 100% occupancy and 30 occupiers; a Hilton hotel sits inside the park. WeWork runs centres in Cherry Hills, Sunriver and GolfLinks blocks. Yahoo (R&D closed 2014) and Microsoft (now at Ferns Galaxy, Vigyan and Bagmane Capital per its own page) were historic occupiers and are not listed as current tenants.

techParks.name: Embassy Icon
techParks.description: Embassy office building on Infantry Road beside Embassy Point; no tenant verified in this run.

techParks.name: Embassy One
techParks.description: Mixed-use tower complex on Bellary Road at the start of the airport road, with the Four Seasons hotel, residences and the Pinnacle office tower that houses Embassy REIT's own principal office and Illumina India.

techParks.name: Embassy Point
techParks.description: Embassy Group's original corporate-office building at 150 Infantry Road (the group has since moved its HQ to Pinnacle Tower, Hebbal).

techParks.name: Embassy Quest
techParks.description: Embassy office building on Magrath Road operated as a WeWork centre.

techParks.name: Embassy Square
techParks.description: Embassy Group office building at 148 Infantry Road beside Embassy Point and Embassy Icon; no tenant could be verified in this run.

techParks.name: Embassy TechVillage
techParks.description: Integrated SEZ/non-SEZ office park on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli (Bellandur), begun in 2008 as Vrindavan Tech Village and renamed after Embassy Office Parks bought the controlling stake in May 2014 (INR 1,951 crore, 106 acres). Embassy REIT acquired it for about INR 97.8 billion (USD 1.3 billion) in December 2020. REIT disclosures give an 84.05-acre site (the 2018 and 2023 press releases say 103 acres), 9.2 msf leasable (6.1 msf completed, 3.1 msf development as of FY21), 97-98% occupancy and 40+ occupiers employing 45,000+ people. Blocks are named after flowers and plants: Hibiscus (Block 2B, Towers 1-3), Gardenia (2D), Iris (3A), Primrose (7B), Trillium (Blocks I & J), Alyssa/Begonia/Clover (Flipkart's three linked towers), plus numbered blocks 1, 2A-2D, 3A-3B, 5A-5L, 7, 8A-8D, 9A-9C and Block L (WeWork). Parcel 9 is JPMorgan Chase's 1.1 msf built-to-suit corporate centre (opened August 2023); Parcel 8 is a 1.9 msf mixed-use parcel with four office towers and a 518-key dual-branded Hilton / Hilton Garden Inn, facing the ORR and a proposed Metro station. IGBC Platinum green campus (2017) and LEED Platinum O+M.

techParks.name: EPIP Zone Whitefield
techParks.description: KIADB's Export Promotion Industrial Park, the 1990s industrial-to-IT zone around ITPL and Kundalahalli; TCS's Abhilash and L-Centre, the former Mindtree and LTI Whitefield campuses, Infinite's head office, Mphasis's Mascot building, DivyaSree NR Enclave (Mastek) and NTT DATA GDS sit here. Point is the midpoint of the verified sites (no single OSM polygon).

techParks.name: Exora Business Park
techParks.description: Prestige-developed office park on the Outer Ring Road at Bellandur Khane village, adjoining Cessna Business Park and also known as Prestige Tech Park II; Yulu Bikes' registered office is on the 2nd floor of Wing A. The geocoder resolved the neighbouring Cessna frontage, so the point is approximate and no bbox is given.

techParks.name: Fairway Business Park
techParks.locality: Challaghatta, off Domlur Inner Ring Road
techParks.description: Office complex next to Embassy GolfLinks; registered office of Jana Small Finance Bank.

techParks.name: Global Technology Park
techParks.description: Mapletree's SEZ office park on the ORR at Bellandur, between RMZ Ecospace and RMZ Ecoworld; OSM places LinkedIn's Bengaluru office inside its polygon (attribution unverified against a company source).

techParks.name: Global Village Tech Park
techParks.locality: Mylasandra, Mysore Road (RVCE Post, Kengeri Hobli)
techParks.description: 120-acre SEZ campus off the Bengaluru-Mysuru highway, renamed Sattva Global City; anchors are Mindtree's (now LTIMindtree) West Campus, Mphasis's Towers E/F and GTV unit, and Sonata Software's Sonata Towers corporate office. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: Godrej Downtown (OSM name)
techParks.description: Commercial building ('Tower 1') on Kodigehalli Main Road at Bellary Road, 400 m north of Brigade Opus, that OSM names 'Godrej Downtown'; the name and developer could not be corroborated with the search budget exhausted, so treat the park name as provisional. OSM records ten office tenants here, including Hitachi Energy India's headquarters.

techParks.name: Gold Hill Excelsior Park
techParks.description: Gold Hill's software park in Electronics City Phase 2 beside TCS Think Campus and Tech Mahindra (North Wing / South Wing buildings in OSM); a Siemens node sits inside it in OpenStreetMap. Gold Hill Supreme Park lies just south on Infosys Avenue.

techParks.name: Gopalan Global Axis
techParks.description: Gopalan Enterprises' SEZ park (Plot 152, Hoody Village) in the EPIP zone; TCS occupies the B, C, D and H blocks and Infinite Computer Solutions Block 2(A1). Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: GR Tech Park
techParks.description: Completed Salarpuria Sattva office park listed as 'Sattva GR Tech Park, Whitefield'; Nominatim places it on Whitefield Road at Belathur (east of ITPB), i.e. outside the Mahadevapura cluster this lens expected. No tenant could be confirmed.

techParks.name: HAL Bangalore Complex
techParks.description: The government aerospace cluster around HAL Airport: HAL's Bangalore Complex (Aircraft, Overhaul, Foundry & Forge, Aerospace, LCA Tejas divisions), Helicopter Complex and Design Complex line HAL Old Airport Road from Vimanapura to Marathahalli, with URSC, NAL Kodihalli and ADA on the same road. Centroid is the Vimanapura locality; bbox is the union of the mapped HAL/URSC/NAL/ARDC polygons.

techParks.name: HCL Technologies SEZ Jigani
techParks.description: HCLTech's owned SEZ campus (No. 129) in the Jigani industrial area at the southern edge of the metro, its largest Bengaluru site. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: Helios Business Park
techParks.description: Multi-tower office park on the service road of the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli, opposite New Horizon College; its towers host flex-office operators (IndiQube, The Executive Centre) and startups such as Ninjacart (Tower E). Coordinates and bbox are the OSM landuse polygon.

techParks.name: Hinduja Ecopolis
techParks.description: Hinduja Realty's office development on Bellary Road at Kogilu, north of Yelahanka, mapped as commercial in OSM (way/1079506848); no tenant could be identified.

techParks.name: Hoskote Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB industrial area east of the city on the Chennai highway; site of Volvo's Indian truck and bus plant.

techParks.name: IBC Knowledge Park
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Golf View Homes
aliases: Golf View Homes Wind Tunnel Road
techParks.description: A cluster of three office towers plus an IndiQube managed-office centre on NAL Wind Tunnel Road at Murugeshpalya, behind the HAL Old Airport Road frontage. Enphase Energy's India office is at IndiQube Golf View Homes per its own contact page; OSM also records nference, Ipsos, DDB Mudra, ansrsource and (historically) Omega Healthcare here.

techParks.name: IndiQube Grandeur
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Grape Garden (coworking)
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Logos
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Penta
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Sapphire
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Symphony
techParks.description: Managed-office building at 25 MG Road operated by IndiQube; Khaitan & Co occupies three floors of Tower 2.

techParks.name: Infosys Electronics City Campus
techParks.description: Infosys's ~80-acre owned global headquarters campus on Hosur Road (No. 44, Infosys Avenue), the company's registered office and largest single site. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: International Tech Park Bangalore
techParks.description: The 1994 Singapore-Karnataka joint-venture tech park that seeded Whitefield's IT corridor, now run by CapitaLand (ex-Ascendas) with SEZ and non-SEZ towers (Discoverer, Explorer, Pioneer, Creator, Victor, Anchor, Aviator and others); TCS occupies six buildings and HCLTech the Aviator building. Centre point estimated from the mapped TCS and Aviator buildings.

techParks.name: ISRO HQ Campus (Antariksh Bhavan)
techParks.description: The Department of Space / ISRO headquarters campus (Antariksh Bhavan) on New BEL Road, which also houses the Human Space Flight Centre, NSIL's registered office and Antrix. Polygon is OSM way/42396273.

techParks.name: ITC Infotech Park
techParks.description: ITC's own corporate campus at 18 Banaswadi Main Road, north of Ulsoor, housing ITC Infotech's global headquarters alongside the LEED-platinum ITC Green Centre. Confirmed by ITC Infotech's contact page; OSM polygon 'ITC'.

techParks.name: Jigani Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB industrial estate at Jigani, south-west of Bommasandra (OSM operator KIADB, way/103293010), mixing granite exporters and small engineering units with Otis's No. 92 elevator factory, LAPP India's cable plant, Velankani Electronics Unit-3 and Tata Advanced Systems' 2025 composite-structures facility; HCLTech's SEZ sits on its north-east edge.

techParks.name: John F. Welch Technology Centre
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: Kadugodi Industrial Area
techParks.description: Small KIADB industrial area at Kadugodi behind Whitefield, home to Wipro GE Healthcare's headquarters and medical-equipment plant.

techParks.name: Kalyani Magnum
techParks.description: Kalyani Developers' office campus off Bannerghatta Road at Doresanipalya, JP Nagar 7th Phase; Oracle India and the ex-VMware (now Broadcom) software campus are mapped here.

techParks.name: Kalyani Platina
techParks.description: Kalyani Developers' campus at Kundalahalli Village opposite Brookefield Hospital (OSM polygon 'Kalyani Tech Park'); HP's historic Bengaluru campus - HP Inc's ECN office is the 'KTP Ebony' building and HPE's Bengaluru base is mapped here.

techParks.name: Karle Town Centre SEZ
techParks.description: Karle Infra's mixed-use SEZ on Kempe Gowda Main Road, Nagavara, just west of Manyata: office hubs (Hub 1, Hub 2, Hub 4 mapped in OSM, more under construction), the Manpho convention centre and residential towers. Tenants confirmed only from OSM: Epsilon (Hub 2), Vervent (Hub 1) and a Smartworks managed-office centre. The brief's guesses of Nokia, Goldman Sachs, Lowe's, Philips, Ericsson, Shell and Target were not borne out: Lowe's own site puts it at Manyata, Carelon (ex-Legato) now lists Manyata and Bagmane only, and OSM's Nokia/Target/Philips POIs all fall inside Manyata. Developer site returned 503.

techParks.name: Khanija Bhavan
techParks.description: State-owned office block at 49 Race Course Road housing Mysore Minerals, Trigent Software's HQ, an ABB research presence and the Bengaluru Arbitration Centre.

techParks.name: KIADB Hardware Park
techParks.description: KIADB's electronics-hardware industrial estate east of Bellary Road near the airport; OSM maps a Hengst filtration plant inside it. Most occupiers are small manufacturers not individually verified.

techParks.name: Kirloskar Business Park
techParks.description: Mid-rise business park on Bellary Road beside the Hebbal flyover, developed on Kirloskar group land. OSM maps the park (way/265565391) and a Mahindra Comviva POI inside it; Comviva's current address list does not include it. The lens brief's guesses of Rolls-Royce, Dell, Siemens and Volvo here could not be substantiated: Rolls-Royce's own site places its Bengaluru centre at Manyata, and no source was reached for the others.

techParks.name: L&T Tech Park
techParks.description: L&T Realty's SEZ campus on the 65-acre L&T land parcel on Bellary Road next to GKVK, housing LTTS (Tower S1) and LTIMindtree (Tower S2), with a second phase under construction. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: Mantri Commercio
techParks.description: Mantri Developers' twin-tower office building on the Outer Ring Road near Sakra World Hospital; Blue Yonder (formerly JDA) keeps its Bengaluru office in Tower A.

techParks.name: Manyata Tech Park
techParks.locality: Nagavara (Nagawara), Hebbal Outer Ring Road, north Bengaluru
techParks.description: Bengaluru's largest office park and the anchor of the city's northern corridor: about 300 acres at Nagavara on the Hebbal stretch of the Outer Ring Road, operational since 2001, with 12.8 msf completed and 3.1 msf under construction per Embassy Group (press coverage in 2026 puts leasable area near 17 msf across 25+ buildings) and 100,000+ workers from 60+ MNCs. Blocks carry both a letter code and a tree name: L1 Banyan, L2 Willow, L3 Hazel, H2 Mountain Ash, F2 Mahogany, E1 Beech, M2 Madhuvana, M3 (ANZ's built-to-suit), plus Redwood, Silver Oak, Silver Fir, Pine, Cedar, Balsa, Eucalyptus, Mulberry, Ebony, Teak, Poplar, Palm, Aspen, Cypress, Elm, Acacia and Green Heart, and the newer Manyata NXT towers beside the dual-branded Hilton hotels at the south gate. Greenheart Tech Park (~1.5 msf) is a strata-owned parcel inside the campus; MFAR developed another parcel. Anchor occupiers are IBM, Cognizant, Target and Oracle Health (Cerner), with Nokia (511k sq ft), ANZ (618k sq ft, Building M3), Target (831k sq ft from Sep 2025) and Commonwealth Bank of Australia (0.8-1.4 msf built-to-suit due late 2026) the largest recent leases.
notableTenants: Bath & Body Works (Mast Global Business Services)

techParks.name: Marksquare
techParks.description: Office building at 61 St Mark's Road shared by EY (3rd-4th floors) and Trilegal (6th-7th floors).

techParks.name: Mittal Tower
techParks.description: Older office tower at 47/6 MG Road near Trinity Circle; HSBC's MG Road branch is recorded by OSM just beside it. No large tenant verified.

techParks.name: NetApp Bangalore Campus
techParks.description: NetApp's own corporate campus on ITPL Main Road at Hoodi, its largest engineering site outside the United States.

techParks.name: North Gate Business Park
techParks.description: Three-phase office park on Bellary Road (NH 44) at Yelahanka, opposite the car dealerships strip; Phases 1 and 2 are operational and Phase 3 under construction per OSM. Tenants are from OSM POIs: Collins Aerospace's EDTC and Pratt & Whitney India (both RTX) in Phase 2, an Infosys office, and a WeWork centre in Phase 1. Developer not confirmed; no developer page could be reached.

techParks.name: Oracle Tech Hub
techParks.description: Oracle's own named campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli ORR at Kadubeesanahalli, one block north of Cessna Business Park and about 1.2 km north of ETV; Oracle's India field-office list gives 'Oracle Tech Hub Block C, No.169/1, BBMP Ward No.150-Bellandur'. It is NOT part of Embassy TechVillage, which is why the lens's 'Cerner / Oracle Health?' candidate is recorded under Oracle rather than as an ETV tenant.

techParks.name: Oracle Technology Park
techParks.description: Oracle India's own campus on Bannerghatta Road, S.G. Palya (OSM polygon 'Oracle Technology Park'), its main Bengaluru site alongside Kalyani Magnum and the Prestige Tech Park hub.

techParks.name: Ozone Manay Tech Park
techParks.description: Mid-rise IT park on the service road of Hosur Road at Garvebhavipalya, mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/1257330725; no tenant could be confirmed from a company page during this run, so the tenant list is left empty.

techParks.name: Peenya Industrial Area
techParks.description: One of Asia's largest industrial areas, laid out from the late 1970s on the Tumkur Road (NH-4) in north-west Bengaluru: about 1,461 acres in four phases hosting some 13,000 MSMEs in machine tools, electrical goods, die-casting, hydraulics and textiles, notified as a Special Investment Region in 2025. Anchors include ABB's campus, Kirloskar Electric's corporate office, Ace Designers, Wipro's hydraulics works and ISRO's ISTRAC mission-control centre.

techParks.name: Prestige Central
techParks.description: Office building at 36 Infantry Road; WeWork India's registered office and Infantry Road centre.

techParks.name: Prestige Centre Point
techParks.description: Office building at 7 Cunningham Road; no tenant verified in this run.

techParks.name: Prestige Emerald
techParks.description: Office building at Municipal No. 2 Madras Bank Road; OSM records Mitsubishi Electric India and Shimizu Corporation.

techParks.name: Prestige Falcon Tower
techParks.description: Office tower at 19 Brunton Road off MG Road; Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas's Bengaluru office.

techParks.name: Prestige Featherlite Tech Park
techParks.locality: Plot 148, EPIP Zone Phase 2, Whitefield Road (Kaveri Nagar / Doddanekundi side)
techParks.description: Small Prestige office building at Plot 148, EPIP Zone, Whitefield Road, opposite KTPO and beside Sattva's Mindcomp Tech Park, marketed largely as serviced/startup space (INR 14,000 per seat per month in one listing). No anchor tenant could be confirmed; OSM places Srijan Technologies inside it. Not to be confused with Prestige Featherlite Tech Hub in Kadubeesanahalli.

techParks.name: Prestige Ferns Galaxy
techParks.description: Prestige campus on the Sarjapur ORR at Bellandur housing the Microsoft India Development Center's Bengaluru site, which Microsoft's IDC pages call 'BLR Ferns'.

techParks.name: Prestige Khoday Tower
techParks.description: Grade-A office tower at 5 Raj Bhavan Road next to Cubbon Park; OSM records The Executive Centre and Frauscher Sensor Technology as tenants.

techParks.name: Prestige Lakeshore Drive
techParks.description: Prestige office development on the Bellandur lakefront off the ORR (phase 2 under construction per OSM); an OSM 'Uber' POI falls inside it, the only location evidence for Uber's Bengaluru tech hub.

techParks.name: Prestige Loka
techParks.description: Office building at 202 Brunton Road; OSM records SatSure, KaleidEO and DSK Legal.

techParks.name: Prestige Meridian
techParks.description: Pair of office towers at 29-30 MG Road; historically Citibank's Bengaluru branch (now Axis Bank after the 2023 consumer-business sale) and a cluster of OSM-recorded insurers and mutual funds.

techParks.name: Prestige Minsk Square
techParks.description: Prestige's newest CBD office building at Municipal No. 6 Cubbon Road; Apple India's registered office since it left UB City.

techParks.name: Prestige Nebula
techParks.description: Office building at 12 Queen's Road / Cubbon Road, part of the Prestige cluster around Minsk Square; no tenant verified in this run.

techParks.name: Prestige Obelisk
techParks.description: Office tower at 3 Kasturba Road opposite Cubbon Park; OSM records JSA, Livspace, Indeed, Infor, Rockwell Automation, Allergan and ICICI Venture here.

techParks.name: Prestige Shantiniketan
techParks.description: Prestige Group's 105-acre mixed-use township on Whitefield Main Road whose Crescent 1-4 and Tower A-C office blocks host a dense cluster of IT services tenants (TCS, Tata Elxsi, Hexaware, Persistent, Coforge, Quest Global, Zensar). Point from Nominatim.

techParks.name: Prestige Sterling Square
techParks.description: Small Prestige office building off Lavelle Road; OSM records Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas and Nexus Venture Partners.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Cloud
techParks.description: Prestige Group's office park on the Bellary Road airport corridor at Bagalur, south of the airport trumpet. OSM maps the park as commercial (way/899211359) with Walmart and Tata Agratas POIs; Prestige's project page refused automated access (403), so size and status are unconfirmed.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Pacific Park
techParks.locality: Kadubeesanahalli (Outer Ring Road, beside Cessna Business Park)
techParks.description: Prestige office park on the ORR immediately south of Cessna Business Park; OSM maps Walmart Labs / Walmart Global Tech's Bengaluru centre inside it.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Park
techParks.description: Prestige Group's campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli, built as named blocks (Mercury, Etamin, Exora, Falcon, Lotus); it houses Nutanix's 200,000 sq ft India HQ in the Mercury Block and Confluent's engineering hub in Etamin, with Adobe and Amadeus among other mapped tenants.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Platina
techParks.description: Prestige's 'Platina Technology Park' at the northern end of the Prestige Tech Park cluster on the ORR; Adobe's main Bengaluru office is Building 1, Block A (address from Adobe's office list; point is the OSM Adobe POI).

techParks.name: Prestige Technostar
techParks.locality: Doddanekundi Industrial Area 2, Phase 1, Brookefield (ITPL Main Road)
techParks.description: Prestige Group's ~8.5-acre, ~10.5 lakh sq ft office park on ITPL Main Road in the Doddanekundi Industrial Area, with B1-B3 blocks, food courts and The Executive Centre's serviced offices on Level 8 of B3. Tenant disclosure is thin; AMD, o9 Solutions and Netskope are mapped inside it on OSM.

techParks.name: Prestige Terminus
techParks.locality: Konena Agrahara, HAL Old Airport Road (opposite HAL)
techParks.description: Two Prestige office blocks on the Airport Arrival Road spur off HAL Old Airport Road, next to the old HAL airport terminal. Recorded in OSM; no tenant could be substantiated in this pass.

techParks.name: Prestige Trade Tower
techParks.description: Prestige's tallest CBD office tower on Palace Road, anchored by Deloitte (OSM names the building 'Prestige Deloitte') with The Executive Centre serviced offices.

techParks.name: Purva Premiere
techParks.description: Office building at 135 Residency Road; Unisys's Bengaluru centre per OSM.

techParks.name: Raheja Towers
techParks.description: 1990s twin office block at 26-27 MG Road; OSM mappers record Standard Chartered's branch, Regus, HCL Infosystems, JSW Steel and several insurers here.

techParks.name: Rajajinagar Industrial Estate
techParks.description: 1950s-era state industrial estate along Chord Road in Rajajinagar, now a mix of small engineering units, the Government Tool Room and Training Centre, and the KSSIDC IT park where ABB sits (OSM way 58516968).

techParks.name: Rajajinagar IT Park
techParks.description: A small Karnataka State Small Industries Development Corporation IT/BT park inside the Rajajinagar Industrial Estate on Chord Road; ABB India's Bengaluru engineering office (Plot 1-4, 18th A Main) is its known anchor. Mapped as a commercial landuse in OSM (way 781588921).

techParks.name: RGA Tech Park
techParks.description: SEZ office park on Sarjapur Main Road beyond Wipro's Kodathi campus; LTTS runs its SEZ Unit VI in Block 3. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: RMZ Ecospace
techParks.description: RMZ's SEZ campus on the Bellandur stretch of the ORR; its numbered 'Campus' buildings sit inside the Pritech Park SEZ, so addresses are written either way (Intuit: 'Campus 4A, Pritech Park (Ecospace)'; Broadcom: 'Ecospace Campus 1A and 1C'). PayPal's Bengaluru centre is mapped here.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecoworld
techParks.description: RMZ's large campus east of Ecospace on the Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli, built as numbered buildings (Ecoworld 1 to 8) with an SEZ; Cadence's Bengaluru design centre is mapped at Campus 4A/4B on RMZ Ecoworld Road, and OSM records SAP Ariba and Microsoft offices nearby. Centroid is a Nominatim hit on 'RMZ Ecoworld Internal Road', not a polygon.

techParks.name: RMZ Galleria
techParks.description: RMZ's mixed-use Galleria at Yelahanka on Bellary Road: a mall, residences and an Office Block whose 10th-12th floors house Comviva's main Bengaluru office.

techParks.name: RMZ Infinity
techParks.description: Five-tower (A-E) RMZ office campus at No.3 Old Madras Road beside Benniganahalli and the Swami Vivekananda Road metro station. Google's own locations page lists its 'Old Madras Road' office here and Calix lists Tower B; OSM also records LSEG, EY, Alcon, Analog Devices and Thomson Reuters floors. Sabre, Wells Fargo and Kotak were suggested by the lens prompt but could not be confirmed here (Sabre now lists ITPB, Wells Fargo maps to Embassy TechVillage).

techParks.name: RMZ Latitude
techParks.developer: RMZ Corp (portfolio acquired by Brookfield Properties, 2020)
techParks.description: Office complex on Bellary Road, Hebbal (near the Godrej apartments): RMZ Latitude Commercial with a WeWork on the 10th floor, and the adjacent 'Azure' tower that OSM attributes to Brookfield Properties, where OSM places Alcon, Mott MacDonald, Dayforce (Ceridian), Enercon and Boeing offices. Only the WeWork is confirmed from a primary page.

techParks.name: RMZ Millenia
techParks.description: Two-tower RMZ business park on Murphy Road, Ulsoor, next to the Israeli consulate. The only tenant evidenced in this pass is TMEIC's Bengaluru branch (OSM); the Deloitte, Oracle, Fidelity, Goldman Sachs and Ericsson names suggested for it could not be confirmed (their evidenced Bengaluru offices are elsewhere).

techParks.name: RMZ Titanium
techParks.description: RMZ office building at 135 HAL Old Airport Road, Kodihalli, opposite the Leela Palace. OSM nodes from 2015 name GKN Aerospace, FICO (Fair Isaac), CA Technologies, Amber Road, AmiCorp and Hyder Consulting as tenants, but none could be confirmed from company pages and several have since been acquired or moved, so no tenant is asserted.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Magnificia
techParks.description: Salarpuria Sattva office block at 78 Old Madras Road (Swamy Vivekananda Road) near Tin Factory junction, Benniganahalli. OSM places OSB India, a Sattva office and a (possibly former) WeWork centre here and KreditBee just west of it; WeWork India's current Bengaluru list no longer names Old Madras Road. Pin is the OSM WeWork POI; no polygon is drawn.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Mindcomp Tech Park
techParks.locality: EPIP Zone Phase 2, Whitefield Road (Kaveri Nagar / Doddanekundi side)
techParks.description: Completed Salarpuria Sattva office park ('Sattva Mindcomp Tech Park, Whitefield' on the developer's project list) on the EPIP Zone frontage of Whitefield Road, adjoining Prestige Featherlite Tech Park and the STT data centre. No tenant could be confirmed from a primary or press source; Microchip Technology's Plot 149-B office lies on its edge.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Softzone
techParks.description: Sattva Group's 1.0 msf SEZ on the Bellandur stretch of the ORR (91% committed as of Mar 2025), under 1 km from the coming Bellandur and Iblur metro stations; OSM maps SAP Labs India's ORR office and a Dell office here.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Windsor
techParks.description: Office building at 3 Ulsoor Road; Sattva Group's corporate office.

techParks.name: SAP Labs India Campus
techParks.description: SAP's own campus at #138 EPIP Zone, Whitefield - headquarters of SAP Labs India, SAP's largest R&D centre outside Germany (OSM polygon 'SAP Labs').

techParks.name: SAP Labs India Innovation Park
techParks.description: SAP Labs India's second Bengaluru campus on the airport corridor beside Shell's technology centre, with buildings BLR11, BLR12 and BLR13 mapped in OSM (way/1177291323).

techParks.name: Sattva Horizon
techParks.description: Sattva Group's office building on Bellary Road at Yelahanka, between North Gate Business Park and Hinduja Ecopolis; OSM records an Amazon office in it (unverified).

techParks.name: Shell Technology Centre Bangalore
techParks.locality: KIADB Hardware Park (SEZ), Mahadevakodigehalli, Bagalur / Devanahalli
techParks.description: Shell's 52-acre, purpose-built R&D campus near Kempegowda International Airport, opened March 2017 for up to 1,500 scientists and engineers, consolidating Bengaluru teams previously spread across the city; one of Shell's three global technology hubs (with Amsterdam and Houston).

techParks.name: Shilpitha Tech Park
techParks.description: Compact tech-office building on Outer Ring Road at Devarabisanahalli, opposite Sakra World Hospital, best known as Shadowfax Technologies' registered and corporate office (3rd floor). OSM polygon centroid.

techParks.name: SJR Primeco Union City
techParks.description: SJR Primeco's office complex on ITPL Main Road, Whitefield, next to Prestige Shantiniketan; Block B hosts Plum Benefits (6th floor). OSM polygon centroid and bbox.

techParks.name: SKAV 909
techParks.description: Boutique office building on Lavelle Road; OSM records MiQ, athenahealth, Awfis and (formerly) Bain and Tesla India here.

techParks.name: Sumadhura Capitol Towers
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: TCS Think Campus
techParks.locality: Electronics City Phase 2, Shantipura Main Road
techParks.description: Tata Consultancy Services' Bengaluru flagship campus in Electronics City Phase 2, mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/188314420 with its entrance on Shantipura Main Road; Wikipedia's Electronic City article names TCS's main campus among the township's anchors.

techParks.name: The Estate
techParks.description: Office building at 121 Dickenson Road off MG Road; OSM records Havells India, ACC, Mitsubishi Elevators and Razorfish among its tenants (unverified).

techParks.name: The Pavilion
techParks.description: Office building at 62/63 Church Street run as a WeWork centre.

techParks.name: Trifecta Adatto
techParks.description: Office tower at No.21 ITPL Main Road, Garudachar Palya, on the KR Puram-Mahadevapura border. Quantiphi's contact page confirms its Bengaluru office here and OSM records a McKinsey service centre (and a Flipkart office, not asserted).

techParks.name: UB City
techParks.description: Bengaluru's flagship CBD development (completed 2008, >1.6 million sq ft) with four office towers - UB Tower, Canberra, Concorde and Comet/Kingfisher - over The Collection luxury mall; home to the UB/Diageo spirits HQs and several strategy and audit firms.

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Park
techParks.description: Two-tower (North/South) office park by the Vaishnavi Group at Bellandur Gate on Sarjapur Main Road, largely leased to flex-space operators (Smartworks) whose tenants include Onsurity. OSM polygon centroid and bbox.

techParks.name: Veerasandra Industrial Estate
techParks.description: KIADB industrial estate on the east side of Hosur Road forming the southern part of Electronics City Phase 2; company addresses here read 'Veerasandra Village, Attibele Hobli, Anekal Taluk'. Holds Titan's 'Integrity' corporate office, Tessolve and Aurigene on Jogger's Lane, Continental and Velankani Electronics Unit-2.

techParks.name: Velankani Tech Park
techParks.locality: 43, Electronics City Phase 1, Hosur Main Road
techParks.description: Velankani Group's own IT park at #43 Electronic City Phase 1, Hosur Main Road, housing the group's IT and hospitality businesses including The Oterra hotel (OSM places 'The Oterra Bengaluru Electronics City' inside the polygon).

techParks.name: Vigyan
techParks.description: Standalone office building at 9 Lavelle Road long occupied by Microsoft India (R&D).

techParks.name: WeWork Galaxy
techParks.description: Former Galaxy cinema site at 43 Residency Road, rebuilt as a WeWork flagship and the CBD's best-known startup coworking address.

techParks.name: Wipro Electronic City Campus
techParks.description: Wipro's multi-tower Electronics City delivery campus (EC1, EC2/3 with its Learning Centre and Executive Briefing Centre, and EC4 across the road), mapped in OpenStreetMap as Towers 1-23 along Wipro Avenue; Wikipedia's Electronic City article names it among the township's main campuses.

techParks.name: Wipro SEZ Sarjapur
techParks.description: Wipro's owned Doddakannelli campus on Sarjapur Road: the SJP1 corporate office and the adjoining SJP2 SEZ development centre. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: World Trade Center Bengaluru (Brigade Gateway)
techParks.description: The 128 m, 32-storey World Trade Center Bengaluru (completed 2010, WTCA-licensed, ~1.1 million sq ft with 40,000 sq ft floor plates) anchors Brigade Gateway, Brigade Group's 40-acre mixed-use enclave on Dr Rajkumar Road with Orion Mall, Sheraton Grand, Manipal Hospital, Brigade School and 1,200+ flats. The low-rise WTC Annexe (over 1 lakh sq ft, home to Brigade's BuzzWorks managed offices since March 2024) stands beside it. Amazon India has held ~18 floors since opening but announced in Nov 2024 a move to a Sattva site near the airport.

techParks.name: Yelahanka Industrial Estate
techParks.description: KIADB/KHB industrial estate at Yelahanka New Town, next to the Rail Wheel Factory: Centum Electronics' head office (44 KHB Industrial Area), Cargill's Provimi animal-nutrition unit and the former SLK Software (now Altimetrik) site.

provenance.note: Merged by tools/data/merge.py from the research slices in data/raw/. Office coordinates come from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Nominatim/Photon/Overpass or from the park's centroid; see each office's evidence line.
